{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build-DEB

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  BIN_NAME: quantum_launcher
  PROJECT_NAME: quantum_launcher
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  DEB:
    name: Build DEB
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false # don't fail other jobs if one fails
      matrix:
        build: [x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux]
        include:
          - build: x86_64-linux
            os: ubuntu-latest
            rust: stable
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            cross: false
            arch: x86_64
          - build: aarch64-linux
            os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            rust: stable
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            cross: false
            arch: aarch64

    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install ${{ matrix.rust }} toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install ${{ matrix.rust }} --no-self-update
          rustup default ${{ matrix.rust }}
          rustup target add ${{ matrix.target }}
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" == "true" ]; then
            cargo install cross --locked
          fi

      - name: Build release binary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" == "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          fi

      - name: Build DEB
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install fakeroot
          mkdir -p dist build

          install -D "assets/freedesktop/quantum-launcher.desktop" "build/usr/share/applications/quantum-launcher.desktop"
          install -D "assets/freedesktop/quantum-launcher.metainfo.xml" "build/usr/share/metainfo/quantum-launcher.metainfo.xml"
          install -D "assets/icon/256x256/ql_logo.png" "build/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/io.github.Mrmayman.QuantumLauncher.png"
          install -D "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ env.BIN_NAME }}" "build/usr/bin/quantum-launcher"
          mv "assets/freedesktop/debian" "build/DEBIAN"
          fakeroot dpkg-deb --build build dist/$PROJECT_NAME-${{ matrix.build }}.deb

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: quantum-launcher-ubuntu-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: dist",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds a Rust workspace that has a Cargo.lock but downloads dependencies on every run with no cache. The dependency-download-cache pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) applies: Cargo.lock satisfies the lockfile precondition, repeated dependency fetching occurs, no equivalent cache exists, and caching the registry/git (not build outputs) preserves build coverage while reducing repeated fetches. The measured fork example shows adding actions/cache keyed on a lockfile hash. fail-fast is intentionally left false because both matrix DEB outputs are required, so no coverage is reduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
